q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: WITH total_drinkers AS (SELECT bar, COUNT(drinker) AS total_num_drinker FROM frequents GROUP BY bar), avg_prices AS (SELECT bar, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves GROUP BY bar), most_reg_drinkers AS (SELECT frequents.bar, frequents.drinker, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY frequents.bar ORDER BY MAX(frequents.times_a_week) DESC, frequents.drinker) AS rnk FROM frequents GROUP BY frequents.bar, frequents.drinker) SELECT bar.name AS bar, COALESCE(total_drinkers.total_num_drinker, 0) AS total_num_drinker, avg_prices.avg_price, CASE WHEN total_drinkers.total_num_drinker = 0 THEN NULL ELSE most_reg_drinkers.drinker END FROM bar LEFT JOIN total_drinkers ON bar.name = total_drinkers.bar LEFT JOIN avg_prices ON bar.name = avg_prices.bar LEFT JOIN (SELECT bar, drinker FROM most_reg_drinkers WHERE rnk = 1) AS most_reg_drinkers ON bar.name = most_reg_drinkers.bar ORDER BY total_num_drinker DESC, bar DESC
